verdict.rationale: Latham & Watkins explicitly states it is "the only global law firm present in all key US and global venture and growth capital hubs — from the Bay Area, Austin, and Boston to London, Hong Kong, and Singapore," directly claiming multi-country offices/practices so founders can expand without needing a new firm. This is reinforced by global capital-markets/M&A and cross-border IP/privacy practice claims. Missing for 10: independent verification of office locations/bar admissions per jurisdiction and client testimonials confirming seamless cross-border handoffs.
